VIP Customers.description: Top-tier customers with highest balances, frequent transactions, and long tenure. They represent the bank's most valuable relationships.

High Net Worth.description: Customers with very high account balances and significant loan portfolios. They may not transact frequently but hold substantial assets.

Dormant Customers.description: Inactive customers with very low recent transaction activity. They are at high risk of attrition and require re-engagement campaigns.
